newsitem.title: UK: First freight train runs through Channel tunnel.
newsitem.headline: First freight train runs through Channel tunnel.

text.p: The fire-damaged Channel tunnel reopened for business early on Thursday when two freight trains used the undersea link to travel from Britain to Europe, an official at operators Eurotunnel said.

"Let me tell you at 5:30 this morning (same GMT) the first freight trains ran into the tunnel from Britain to France," Eurotunnel railway relations manager Jim Evans tolds BBC radio. One train was headed for Germany, the other for Spain.
"We're back in business and we should have the first two north-bound trains at 8:45," Evans said.
Hours earlier the Channel Tunnel safety commission, meeting in the French port of Calais, had given permission for freight trains to resume limited services in either direction.
The tunnel had been closed since a fire on a truck transporter train badly damaged a section of track on Monday.
